topic: A Sanad office in Muscat moved 40 client work permits off WhatsApp — no missed renewals in six months
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
40 permits. Three people. One shared notes doc — with the actual updates buried in a WhatsApp thread nobody could locate.

After switching to SmartPRO Hub: one dashboard. Every permit, every expiry date, every renewal status, visible to the whole team in real time.

Six months in: zero missed renewals.

That's a different operation.

Work permit renewals aren't complicated on paper. The problem is that reminders living in someone's head, or three screens deep in a chat thread, eventually get missed. And a missed permit isn't just an inconvenience — it's a fine, a blocked employee, and a client who remembers it.

SmartPRO Hub built Sanad office management software for exactly this. Not a workaround. Not a color-coded spreadsheet only one person understands. A purpose-built workflow that tracks every permit, sends reminders before deadlines hit, and gives clients visibility through a branded portal. No WhatsApp required.

Sanad didn't stop at 40 permits either. They scaled.

That's the quiet danger of managing renewals through chat: the risk doesn't warn you. Everything looks fine until something slips through, and by then you're already dealing with the fallout.
